reviews.review_title: BEST GAME EVER CREATED FIR APPLAB
reviews.review_description: This is the best fan game ever to play on. It’s so fun with the nicest moderators on the PLANET!!! 🌎 but if u ever play this and see a mod. And that mod says shush 🤫 like me. That means there is someone bad in the game that needs to be taught a lesson to never be mean or anything that breaks code of conduct and so the game doesn’t get shut down. Make sure to change ur n name first thing when u join. Because we don’t want to risk losing a game that was just put in applab. Pls don’t let anyone else get in ur head about rude stuff, always be nice and respect everyone who respects u.
